{{Quote|Regrettably, Quinta's latest holo-vid, ''Denizens of Dakaret IX'', has met with less than spectacular reviews.|Morgraine Delefrenquin, "Your Stars And Mine"|<ref name="Galladinium" />}}
'''''Denizens of Dakaret IX''''' was a [[Holodrama/Legends|holofilm]] featuring the [[Holovid/Legends|holo-vid]] [[Actor/Legends|actress]] [[Quintana Trill]].<ref name="Galladinium" /> It shared its name with the [[Dakaret system/Legends|Dakaret system]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Oktos sector/Legends|Oktos sector]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> and was released at some point by [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref name="Date" />

The holofilm's opening [[Local day/Legends|night]] screening was held at the [[Imperial Cavalcade of Stars]] [[Holotheater/Legends|holotheater]] on<ref name="Galladinium" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]].<ref name="SoR">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref> Trill visited the premiere, arriving at the theater three [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]] before the film's start via a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] and escorted by eight [[Gender/Legends|men]]. She then stunned the spectators waiting outside the holotheater to see her by the [[Color/Legends|colorful]] display generated by the [[Coruscant Cascader BPEA-IA]] device she was wearing. The following day, Society News Editor [[Morgraine Delefrenquin]] of the ''[[Chandrilan Daily Messenger]]'' described in the "[[Your Stars And Mine]]" feature Trill's appearance at the premiere of ''Denizens of Dakaret IX'' while also noting that the film itself had garnered unenthusiastic reviews.<ref name="Galladinium" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Denizens of Dakaret IX'' was mentioned in ''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]'', a [[1995]] sourcebook authored by [[Rick D. Stuart]] for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Galladinium" />
